title: Oda-chan to Akechi-kun
titleNative: 織田ちゃんと明智くん
synopsis: I should not be falling in love with this person... Enemy or lovers? The fiercest rivals in history return! Ryunosuke Akechi is the school's toughest delinquent, while Maria Oda is the beautiful idol of the school. Two people who live in different worlds, they start going out after Akechi confesses his feelings. However, when they kiss for the first time, memories of the fiery betrayal at Honnouji fill their heads...! A turbulent high school life begins, as their present-day love affair becomes intertwined with grudges from the past! (Source: Morning, translated)

synonyms: Bungo Stray Dogs: The Untold Origins of the Detective Agency
synopsis: Over a decade before the events of the manga series, a chance encounter leads professional bodyguard Yukichi Fukuzawa to begrudgingly take an arrogant boy genius named Ranpo Edogawa under his wing. Their first job brings them to a local theater on high alert after receiving a bizarre death threat-a challenge that will require both Ranpo's brains and Fukuzawa's experience. The aftermath spurs Fukuzawa to establish the Armed Detective Agency, an organization that takes on dangerous jobs even the police won't handle! Plus, get a glimpse of the agency the night before Atsushi Nakajima joined the team! (Source: Yen Press)

title: The Delinquent Girl Beside Me Suddenly Dyed Her Hair Black
titleRomaji: Tonari no Seki no Yankee Shimizu-san ga Kami wo Kuroku Sometekita
titleEnglish: The Delinquent Girl Beside Me Suddenly Dyed Her Hair Black
titleNative: 隣の席のヤンキー清水さんが髪を黒く染めてきた
synonyms: The Delinquent Shimizu-san Sitting Next to Me Has Dyed Her Hair Black
synopsis: Why is the toughest girl in school trying to be my type?! "My type? A girl with long black hair who carries herself well." That's what I told my friends during a casual conversation about romance. The very next day, Shimizu— the blonde delinquent who sits next to me— suddenly shows up with her hair dyed black. From then on, every time I mention my ideal girl, she starts doing things she normally wouldn't— showing up to cooking class (which she used to always skip), packing me homemade lunches, etc. (Source: One Peace Books)

title: Eko Eko Azaraku
synopsis: When the chant "Eko Eko Azarak" sounds something is bound to occur, be it within the town or the school! A classic horror manga, Eko Eko Azarak follows the witch Misa Kuroi ("Black Mass" in Japanese), and the various horrors she encounters during her travels. While relatively unknown outside of Japan the series was extremely well received domestically. It lasted for 19 volumes, spawned two sequels, an OVA, two TV series, six live action films and two video games. Included one-shot: Volume 19: Hitokui Ichizoku
